layout.footer: This email was sent by {siteName}. If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email for {siteName}
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body: Hi {name}, please confirm your email address to activate your {siteName} account.
verifyEmail.note: This link expires in 24 hours. If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your {siteName} password
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: Hi {name}, we received a request to reset the password for your {siteName} account.
resetPassword.note: This link expires in 1 hour. If you did not request this, ignore this email — your password will not change.

accountExists.subject: Sign-up attempt with your email on {siteName}
accountExists.heading: You already have an account
accountExists.body: Hi {name}, someone tried to create a new {siteName} account with this email address, but an account already exists.
accountExists.note: If this was not you, no action is needed. If you forgot your password, use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page.

passwordChanged.subject: Your {siteName} password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: Hi {name}, the password for your {siteName} account was just changed. All other sessions were signed out.
passwordChanged.note: If you did not do this, reset your password immediately and contact the site administrator.

twoFactorDisabled.subject: Two-factor authentication was turned off on {siteName}
twoFactorDisabled.heading: Two-factor authentication is off
twoFactorDisabled.body: Hi {name}, two-factor authentication was just turned off for your {siteName} account.
twoFactorDisabled.note: If you did not do this, change your password immediately and turn two-factor authentication back on.
